summary.text: Antoinette Sedillo Lopez is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2019, representing District 16 in Bernalillo County.
Sedillo Lopez is vice chair of the Senate Conservation Committee and also sits on the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Sedillo Lopez's occupation as retired law professor.

Between sessions, Sedillo Lopez is a member of the Courts, Corrections and Justice Committee, the Investments and Pensions Oversight Committee, the Legislative Health and Human Services Committee, and the Radioactive and Hazardous Materials Committee.
